newsitem.title: UK: Cable & Wireless dips on merger delay talk.
newsitem.headline: Cable & Wireless dips on merger delay talk.

text.p: Shares in Cable & Wireless Plc were down 2p at 467-1/2p following press reports that its plans to merge its Mercury phone subsidiary with three cable companies is likely to be delayed, dealers said. The Independent newspaper on Monday said growing disagreements between the companies involved will delay the in the proposed five billion merger planned for April.
"We've seen a small mark down on the Mercury delay story," one dealer said.
"The deal is quite significant and if the story is true we could see the shares come off a bit more."
The newspaper, citing unnamed sources, said a clash of cultures plus the sheer complexity of the task were slowing things down.

The deal, unveiled in October 1996, is set to create the biggest cable television operator in Britain with Mercury joining forces with the British subsidiaries of NYNEX Corp and Bell Canada International.
